wages.text: Jones said policymakers should increase workers’ pay as part of strengthening the economic safety net.
wages.quote: Pay people more, help to reduce the price of goods and make sure you strengthen the safety net

trade.text: Jones criticized tariffs as taxes that increase costs for Arkansans.
trade.quote: tariffs at the end of the day are taxes. And Arkansans don’t like paying taxes to the federal government.

schools.text: Jones called for stronger schools and government investment in early childhood education and workforce training.
schools.quote: Our government should invest in our people. Early childhood education, hands-on apprenticeships, and training in both technology and the trades will prepare our children and our workforce for tomorrow.

tax.text: Voted for appropriations bills that he said would save taxpayers money and restore fiscal discipline.
tax.quote: all while saving taxpayers money. This is another step toward restoring fiscal discipline

trade.text: Said tariffs can be useful when targeted but opposed broad tariffs because they can raise prices and hurt families.
trade.quote: I don’t support across-the-board tariffs. They can have a price level increase at one moment

housing.text: Supported and voted for legislation intended to reduce regulatory barriers and increase the housing supply.
housing.quote: At its core, this bill is about restoring that dream. It lowers costs, cuts red tape, and increases housing supply

schools.text: Voted for an appropriations package that included $500 million for charter schools.

safety.text: Supported appropriations that funded community-oriented policing and law-enforcement grants.
safety.quote: $44 million for the Regional Information Sharing Systems program within the Community Oriented Policing Services (COPS) hiring program.

immigration.text: Supported appropriations providing funding to sustain 22,000 Border Patrol agents and body cameras for immigration-enforcement officers.
immigration.quote: Strengthens U.S. national security and border protections by providing $513 million to sustain 22,000 Border Patrol agents.

abortion.text: Voted for a foreign-affairs appropriations bill that maintained existing pro-life provisions.

voting.text: Supported legislation requiring proof of citizenship to register for federal elections and government-issued photo identification to vote.
voting.quote: The Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act will protect our elections by requiring proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote in federal elections and a valid government-issued photo ID to cast a ballot.
